competing_explanation: The policy may have been updated, the window may be measured from purchase rather than delivery, or standard items may have category-specific exclusions.
hypothesis_statement: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days from delivery.
refutation_criterion: H_R is refuted if the current authoritative policy specifies a different full-refund window for standard items, or if the 30-day window is no longer current or applies only to non-standard items.
